spec.founder_expression: Watch my uniimente-kernel checkout and make sure its HEAD commit is recorded; tell me if it is dirty.
spec.intended_effect: Periodically observe the uniimente-kernel local checkout, keep its HEAD commit hash recorded in the mission's own read-only observations, and surface a local notification whenever the working tree is dirty (uncommitted changes present).

success_checks.description: The repository inspector can report a HEAD commit hash for the kernel checkout.
The repository inspector can report whether the working tree is dirty.

strategies.rationale: git.inspect is the only registered capability that reads HEAD and dirtiness for a local checkout; it directly satisfies both the 'recorded HEAD' and 'know if dirty' effects with a read-only call.
strategies.expected_outcome: Returns current HEAD sha, dirty boolean, and recent log entries for the kernel checkout.

params.title: uniimente-kernel dirty
params.text: The uniimente-kernel checkout has uncommitted changes.

strategies.rationale: Founder asked to be told if the checkout is dirty; a local notification is the lowest-consequence way to surface that fact once git.inspect reports dirty=true. Only fires on the dirty condition, never fabricates state.
strategies.expected_outcome: Founder receives a local macOS notification only when the tracked repo is dirty.

constraints: Only read the fixed path /home/user/uniimente-kernel; do not write to or modify the repository.
Notification text must be derived only from the current git.inspect output, never fabricated.
No spending, no external messages, no publishing.
unacceptable_outcomes: Reporting a dirty checkout as clean or vice versa.
Claiming a HEAD commit that was not actually returned by git.inspect.
Writing to or altering the kernel checkout.

clamped: cone limited to the read-only capabilities the plan uses
